card.name: Inside respiratory drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a split respiratory drug name, mostly the 'rop' in ipratropium. It also fires in zileuton, xanthine and anticholinergic.

modes.label: Ipratropium
modes.description: The 'rop' piece in ipratropium bromide, alone or with albuterol.

modes.label: Other airway drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of other asthma or anticholinergic drug names.

card.plain: It fires partway through the name of an inhaled breathing drug, mainly ipratropium, before the name is finished.
